ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75:25 ratio of low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels to high-intensity white/light-grey speckles across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches localized at the distal tips and leading edges of both lobes; dense, high-frequency white speckling/mottling distributed heterogeneously across a dark black base; vertical high-intensity striations visible at the central fluke-peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-60 degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 3-15 pixels, creating a jagged profile isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex sweep beginning from the median notch and transitioning to a broad curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular high-contrast white rings and clusters concentrated on the right lobe and along the trailing edge of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned linear white pixel strings (rake marks) ranging from 15-80 pixels in length, primarily visible on the mid-to-outer sections of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including circular rosette clusters and linear rake marks; irregular, jagged trailing edge suggestive of repeated mechanical interaction or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced solid white pigmentation patches isolated specifically to the leading-edge corners of the distal tips.
